io.metadata

Class ExcelCustomProperties

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.metadata.ExcelCustomProperties

  • public class ExcelCustomProperties
extends java.lang.Object
    Reads and writes additional custom document properties stored within an OOXML workbook or spreadsheet.

    The workbook is accessed using Apache POI's OPCPackage API rather than loading it into a full XSSFWorkbook object model. This avoids the overhead of constructing the complete workbook model when only document metadata is required.

    Change log:
    • 16 November 2021 - Initial creation.
    • 7 October 2026 - Refactored package location to io.metadata and improved property value extraction.
    Since:
    16 November 2021
